name: Rev. Dr. Samuel Thomas
title: Principal & Professor of Systematic Theology
bio: Rev. Dr. Samuel Thomas has served in ministry and theological education for over 30 years. His research focuses on Reformed Theology and the theology of mission. He is a sought-after speaker and retreat leader.

name: Dr. Grace Mathew
title: Dean of Academics & Associate Professor of Biblical Studies
bio: Dr. Grace Mathew is a passionate biblical scholar with a specialization in New Testament studies. She has published widely on Pauline literature and is committed to integrating scholarship with spiritual formation.

name: Pastor Joel Abraham
title: Dean of Students & Lecturer in Pastoral Theology
bio: Pastor Joel Abraham brings 20 years of pastoral experience to his role. He lectures in counseling, leadership, and pastoral care, drawing from rich ministry experience across urban and rural church contexts.

name: Prof. Mary Daniel
title: Head of Music Department & Professor of Music
bio: Prof. Mary Daniel is an accomplished vocalist and music educator with expertise in church music, worship leadership, and choral direction. She has led worship in conferences across Asia.
specialization: Vocal Training, Worship Theology, Choral Direction

name: Dr. Philip George
title: Professor of Church History
bio: Dr. Philip George is a historian of the early church and the global missionary movement. He teaches Church History I & II and has authored two books on the spread of Christianity in South Asia.

name: Mrs. Esther Paul
title: Lecturer in Old Testament
bio: Mrs. Esther Paul holds an M.Th in Old Testament studies and teaches Hebrew language, Old Testament survey, and exegesis. She is known for making ancient texts come alive for contemporary students.
